name: oot-hyrule-field
description: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, standing in Hyrule Field right after loading the third entry of the file select screen. Static camera, nothing pressed after loading.
notes: The input script walks boot screen -> title -> file select, moves two entries down and loads that save. It only reaches Hyrule Field when the save in the third entry was made there; --save-backup puts such a save in place before every variant.

reference is resolved next to this file and is not shipped: it is a screenshot of YOUR save in the scene. Record it once with `bench.py run ... --record-reference`, open the image and check that it shows Hyrule Field in gameplay (not a menu or a cutscene), then run again without the flag. Rows of the recording run are invalid by design.

If your save stands elsewhere, at another time of day or with other equipment, your reference differs from other contributors'. That is fine for comparing variants on one machine; say so in the PR, because cross-machine numbers then compare slightly different views.

Timed menu inputs occasionally land in the wrong save. The scene check (mean absolute difference of 32x18 downscales, limit scene_threshold of 255) catches that and the row is invalid: just run it again.
